newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco buys 50,000 tonnes wheat - traders.
newsitem.headline: Morocco buys 50,000 tonnes wheat - traders.

text.p: Morocco bought 20,000 tonnes of optional wheat at $173.50 per tonne cost and freight on a cash basis at a tender on Monday, European grain traders said on Tuesday.
Morocco also bought 30,000 tonnes of French wheat at $180.20 per tonne, including freight and the cost of a Coface export credit, they said.
The French wheat is for January 1-10 delivery to the port of Agadir.
The optional-origin wheat is for delivery between January 1 and 10 in two lots of 10,000 tonnes each to the ports of Tangier and Nador.
One exporter said that wheat from the European Union, and most likely France, was expected to cover the optional part of the sale.
